meta.note: Golden regenerated 2026-06-21 after fix/model-exit-faithful-tp12tr15. PR #355 (migration 0006) invented stop_loss_pct=8.0 and disaster_cap_pct=12.0 to satisfy the old Pydantic invariant that required all three of sl/disaster/rug to be non-None. The VALIDATED tp12tr15_t1200 policy (lab source: v31_winner_check.py:15 -> dict(tp=0.12, tr=0.15, timer=1200, holder=None, ratio=None)) has NO stop-loss and NO disaster cap. With sl=8.0 active, STOP_LOSS fired on losers before the tr15 trailing stop or 1200s timer could run, corrupting the observe measurement. This fix: stop_loss_pct=None, disaster_cap_pct=None (migration 0007+0008). Only TAKE_PROFIT_PCT (+12%), RUG_PULL trailing (15% giveback from peak), and AUTO_SELL_TIMER (1200s) can fire. All 5 golden tokens now exit via TAKE_PROFIT_PCT as expected (previously 2 were cut at STOP_LOSS).
